note: Built-in entries only. No weights are shipped. Hugging Face entries are research references recorded from their public model cards; nothing was downloaded, and none of them can play this game.

provenance.source: implemented in this package (R and compiled backend)

limitations: Heuristic evaluation in provisional units, not centipawns
Strength is bounded by the node budget; no strength rating is claimed

architecture.name: square-transformer
architecture.parameter_count: computed after instantiation by the worker
heads: shared candidate MLP over the full legal set
WDL (side to act; win, draw, loss)

resources.note: tiny trains on CPU; research needs an explicit job budget

limitations: Untrained: no policy or value until a checkpoint is trained with g3_train_model()
A short run demonstrates the pipeline, not playing strength

reported.architecture: PyTorch policy/value transformer, 7 blocks, width 256, 8 heads; 64 square tokens plus 3 auxiliary tokens; 4,672-slot conventional chess policy; scalar value head
reported.note: author-reported on the model card; not independently verified

license.evidence: model-card declaration; no standalone licence file was visible in the Hugging Face or GitHub root listings at the evidence date

adapter.reason: Its 8x8 inputs and fixed 4,672-slot UCI policy cannot represent platforms, cross-level squares or transport actions; an adapter needs new input features, a legal-candidate scorer, value retraining, a reviewed conversion from the pickle-based .pt checkpoint, and pinned revision and licence evidence. None of this exists.

limitations: Card acknowledges no tactical lookahead and a weak value head
Reported strength does not transfer to this variant

models.display_name: searchless-chess ViT medium (conventional chess value model; reference only)

reported.architecture: Keras Vision Transformer, one square per patch, width 384, 8 layers, 6 heads; position value output
reported.note: author-reported; the approximately 1960 'Elo' figure is inferred from puzzle performance, not a match rating

license.evidence: model-card declaration and an MIT licence file in the source repository

adapter.reason: Value-only model: it has no legal-action policy, and its 8x8 input geometry cannot encode platforms or overlapping coordinates. A value adapter would need new input features, value retraining on outcomes from this rules profile, a Keras-to-safetensors conversion route and pinned revision evidence. None of this exists.

limitations: Value only: cannot choose actions by itself
Puzzle-derived rating is not a playing rating and does not transfer

reported.architecture: GPT-style move-history models predicting UCI move tokens from a closed 1,973-token vocabulary; needs the repository's own classes (not transformers AutoModel)
reported.note: author-reported; the largest checkpoint generates fully legal games only about half the time under its own evaluation

license.evidence: model-card declaration and an MIT licence file in the source repository

adapter.reason: Its UCI move vocabulary cannot express platform relocation or rotation, and it infers state from move history instead of reading the position; replacing the vocabulary and state encoding amounts to a new model. No adapter exists.

limitations: Sequence model without a legal-action interface
Legality of generated moves is not guaranteed
